query: What does the research say about the effectiveness of AI-powered tutoring systems on student learning outcomes in K–12 mathematics?
research_brief: I want to understand what research evidence exists about the effectiveness of AI-powered tutoring systems on student learning outcomes in K–12 mathematics. Specifically, I am interested in studies that examine how these AI tutoring systems impact student achievement, test scores, conceptual understanding, engagement, and other relevant academic outcomes in K–12 math settings. If possible, summarize the strength and limitations of the evidence, approaches/methodologies used, and note any differences by age group, context, or implementation model. Please prioritize original research articles and official reports (e.g., published in peer-reviewed journals or by reputable educational organizations) from any country and timeframe unless otherwise specified, and link directly to primary sources where possible.

think_reflections: This research question has multiple dimensions: (1) impact on student achievement/test scores, (2) impact on conceptual understanding, (3) impact on engagement or other academic outcomes, (4) strength/limitations of evidence and methodologies, and (5) moderators such as age groups, contexts, or implementation models. For comprehensive coverage, assign one sub-agent for each outcome cluster (achievement/test scores, conceptual understanding, engagement/academic outcomes), one sub-agent for synthesizing strength/limitations/methodologies, and one sub-agent focused on analyzing evidence about moderation by age/context/implementation model. All agents will focus on K-12 mathematics and prioritize high-quality sources.
